verdict.rationale: Evidence shows AI features for decluttering feedback (featurebase-docs-7), an AI support agent (featurebase-docs-10), and AI search answers (featurebase-docs-14), but nothing about an AI assistant that can answer natural-language questions about feedback themes tied to revenue impact. Missing for 10: any conversational AI/analytics query interface, any revenue-impact linkage or scoring, any documentation of theme-based feedback analytics via AI.
